business_summary: Moog Inc. (NYSE: MOG.A, Class A common stock; SEC CIK 67887) is a worldwide designer, manufacturer and systems integrator of high-performance precision motion and fluid controls, reporting in four segments (Space and Defense, Military Aircraft, Commercial Aircraft, Industrial). It sits on the humanoid-actuators chain's roller-screws link (Planetary roller screws & linear guides; heat verdict EMERGING; not money-corner) through its land-systems electromechanical linear actuator line, independently placement-audited PASS on 2026-09-06 (data/mappings/humanoid-actuators.json placement_audits[]). SEC companyfacts gives revenue, operating income, cash flow and capex cleanly through FY2025 (fiscal year ended 2025-09-27); FY2025 revenue was $3.860624 billion. The Q3-2026 Form 8-K (Exhibit 99.1, document release date 2026-07-31) reports record quarterly net sales of $1,117 million, up 15% year over year, and a twelve-month backlog up 23% to $3.3 billion.
